# Event fabric (MQTT)

*platform* · status **proposed** · owner home lab admin · [all SAs](../README.md)

Proposal: one shared publish/subscribe broker that solutions publish events to and subscribe from, instead of wiring point-to-point integrations. The home-lab counterpart of an enterprise data fabric (Kafka on premises): the platform owns the broker, every consuming solution declares its own use of it.
